thread:
Anna_NG: Quick thread — proposal for an operator-level handshake between the policy compiler and the runtime. TL;DR: add a tiny RPC surface for deploy-time validation, runtime liveness checks, and upgrade-safe capability negotiation.

Mike_Chou: +1. We need a clear compatibility/version field so rolling upgrades don't break. Also idempotent validate calls.

Sophia_Lin: Concern: keep this out of the hot path. The runtime mustn't block inference on a long validation call. Make validate a pre-deploy step or async. :thinking: 

Kevin_Ramos: Reuse existing probe endpoints where possible, but we do need richer semantics than a healthcheck. Suggest split surface: Validate (compile-time / preflight), Heartbeat (runtime liveness + metrics), and QueryCapabilities (what policy features this runtime actually supports).

Josh_S: Edge case: if compiler sends a policy using a newer operator opcode, runtime should reply with structured rejection + migration hint, not just "error". We need machine-readable reason codes for rollback automation.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for runtime v2.3 on zone-us-east-1. Observability hook enabled.

Mike_Chou: Proto sketch idea (very small):
```proto
service PolicyOperator {
  rpc Validate(PolicyBlob) returns (ValidateResp); // quick static checks + signature
  rpc Heartbeat(HeartbeatReq) returns (HeartbeatResp); // liveness + token counters
  rpc QueryCapabilities(Empty) returns (Capabilities); // what ops/quantization/seq-len supported
}
message ValidateResp { bool ok = 1; string reason = 2; repeated string hints = 3; int32 compat_level = 4; }
```

Sophia_Lin: Looks good. For performance tests we should measure: validate latency under load, concurrency limits, and impact on tail latency if heartbeat flaps. I can add perf scenarios.

Kevin_Ramos: Operational semantics:
- Validate must be eventual (timeout + best-effort) for canary; can't block traffic.
- Heartbeat should be pushed by runtime every N seconds, and compiler/controller can also poll on demand.
- Capability changes must be monotonic and versioned.

Anna_NG: Ops note: For Dedicated/Private deployments this handshake must be optional/disabled by default (air-gapped customers). Add an opt-in flag and a local-file fallback for validate responses.

Josh_S: Also plan for audit logs: every Validate call should produce an audit entry with policy id, compiler version, and decision. Useful for regressions.

Mike_Chou: For rollout strategy: start with QueryCapabilities only (read-only), then enable Validate in passive mode (returns warnings), then hard-fail mode behind FF. This lets us gather signals.

InfraBot: infra-monitor: added metric policy_operator.validate.duration_seconds (p50/p99) to staging dashboard.

Anna_NG: Action items: I will open a short RFC PR with the proto, backwards compatibility table, and rollout plan.
- Mike: own proto iteration + error codes
- Sophia: add perf tests and dashboard panels
- Kevin: integration checklist for runtime + opt-in config
- Josh: audit log schema + e2e regressions

Any objections or missing pieces?
